about: Other books on the table's sheets (Xanathar's, Tasha's, Fizban's, the 2014 PHB…): each entry names its book

adds.why: Artillerist: add 1d8 to one damage roll of an artificer spell cast through it
adds.name: Arcane Firearm
adds.trigger: An artificer spell you cast through your arcane firearm (a wand, staff or rod)
adds.effect: +1d8 to one of the spell's damage rolls

entries.name: Create Eldritch Cannon
entries.why: making the cannon rolls nothing; its options roll (Mending's 2d6 heals the cannon, not a roll of yours)

entries.name: Detonate Eldritch Cannon
entries.why: Artillerist: a Dex save within 20 ft, half on a success

entries.name: Eldritch Cannon: Flamethrower
entries.why: Artillerist: a Dex save in a 15-ft cone, half on a success

entries.name: Eldritch Cannon: Force Ballista
entries.why: Artillerist: a ranged spell attack; pushed 5 ft on a hit

entries.name: Eldritch Cannon: Protector
entries.why: Artillerist: Temporary Hit Points to itself and each creature within 10 ft

adds.why: Divine Soul: add 2d4 to a failed saving throw or a missed attack roll
adds.name: Favored by the Gods
adds.trigger: A saving throw you fail or an attack roll you miss
adds.cost: once per Short or Long Rest
adds.effect: +2d4 to the total, which can change the outcome

adds.name: Guided Strike
adds.trigger: An attack roll you make, after you see it and before you know if it hits
adds.why: Oath of Conquest: +10 to an attack roll once you've seen it, before you know if it hits (Brett's Roll Audit comment, Nov 10)

entries.name: Undead Steed: Ghostly Stride
entries.why: the steed's own feature (its stat block, app/summons.py), not the rider's roll

adds.name: Dragon-Touched Focus: Chromatic
adds.why: Stirring, Chromatic family: when you use a spell slot on a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage, roll a d6 and add it to one damage roll (Fizban's)

entries.name: Soul Coin
entries.why: Drain Life: Temporary Hit Points from the soul inside (a Bonus Action, 2024 DMG)

entries.name: Absorb Elements
entries.why: Xanathar's: resistance now, and the extra damage rides the first melee hit on your next turn

rolls.name: Absorb Elements
rolls.note: the damage type is the one you absorbed; the first melee hit on your next turn

entries.name: Branding Smite
entries.why: the 2014 Player's Handbook's (the 2024 one has Shining Smite): extra damage on the next weapon hit, not rolled on casting

rolls.name: Branding Smite
rolls.note: the next time you hit with a weapon attack before it ends

entries.name: Depth Charge
entries.why: 7d6, or 9d6 for a creature submerged in a liquid: one or the other, never both

rolls.name: Depth Charge
rolls.note: 9d6 instead for a creature submerged in a liquid

entries.name: Green-Flame Blade
entries.why: Tasha's: a melee weapon attack with the weapon's own damage, and fire that leaps to a second creature; both grow at levels 5, 11 and 17

rolls.name: Green-Flame Blade
rolls.note: added to the weapon's own damage on a hit (from level 5)

rolls.name: Leaping fire
rolls.note: a second creature within 5 ft of the target; before level 5 it's just your spellcasting modifier

entries.name: Lightning Lure
entries.why: Tasha's: a Strength save; the damage only if pulled within 5 ft

rolls.name: Lightning Lure
rolls.note: pulled up to 10 ft toward you on a failed save; the damage only if it ends within 5 ft

entries.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
entries.why: Fizban's: an Intelligence save, half on a success

rolls.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
rolls.note: Incapacitated until the start of your next turn on a failed save

entries.name: Sickening Radiance
entries.why: Xanathar's: a save each time a creature enters the light or starts its turn there

rolls.name: Sickening Radiance
rolls.repeat: a creature entering it or starting its turn there
rolls.note: and a level of Exhaustion on a failed save, until the spell ends
